tex_content.html:
Remark
[Eigenfunction regularity] 1. ch8:8.37\group ch08-generalized-solutions The preceding regularity results imply that every eigenfunction belongs to $L^\infty (\Omega )\cap C^\alpha (\Omega )$ for some $\alpha >0$, is Hölder continuous up to the boundary under the hypotheses of Theorem 8.29, and is smooth in $\Omega $ when the coefficients are smooth.
